interface.longDescription: Generate sound effects and ambience for an attached silent MP4 or MOV clip up to ten seconds and 50 MB. Describe the sounds and output duration, then watch the result inline with playback, fullscreen, Open and Download. Synthesized timing and sounds may vary. Existing dialogue preservation and music licensing are not provided. Start using the tools without Firemoon account linking. An existing Firemoon account can optionally be connected to use its current entitlements.
defaultPrompt: Add gentle footsteps and street ambience to this silent clip.
Add ocean waves to this beach video, without speech or music.

positive.description: Attach the five-second silent sample MP4.
positive.prompt: Add a soft whoosh and warm studio ambience for five seconds, without speech or music.
positive.expected_behavior: Use duration=5, a matching prompt and negative_prompt excluding speech/music. Return a playable video with generated audio.

positive.description: Use a supported silent video source.
positive.prompt: Create a one-second sound-effect version with a brief whoosh.
positive.expected_behavior: Accept duration=1, the lower output duration boundary, and return a video with synthesized audio.

positive.description: Use a supported silent source clip.
positive.prompt: Make a ten-second ambience version with gentle wind, no speech or music.
positive.expected_behavior: Accept duration=10, the upper output duration boundary; return real video and disclose variable timing.

positive.description: Provide a real silent source video URL.
positive.prompt: Add rain ambience to this video URL, avoiding voices, music and thunder.
positive.expected_behavior: Use video_url and negative_prompt for voices/music/thunder; return generated videoUrl and generationId inline.

positive.description: Use the actual generationId from a preceding successful case.
